scope: Input portions of SPECFORGE aggregate-interface R1-R3 under decision 0113; full request stays open for record outputs, field writes and aggregate consumer qualification.

requirements.contract: Actor-local and imported packed record input aliases, nested records/lists, unused declarations and named domains retain declared identity. Unknown/nonpacked types and unsupported root lists/transaction aggregate ports refuse contextually.
requirements.open: Record outputs and optional root-list/variant ports are separate owners.

requirements.contract: Live scalar leaves in supported conditions, set/update, rules and drives preserve resolved paths/properties; explicit scalar sampling retains its existing edge. Nearest lexical shadows, enum namespaces and declared domains remain authoritative.
requirements.open: Whole-record scalar expressions/samples and unsupported contexts retain precise refusals.

requirements.contract: Whole input-to-owned-storage copies require the same recursive resolved type, including member order, width, signed and state facts. Alias-equivalent types pass; equal-width mismatches and input writes refuse. Generated writers route data/enable to the owning register/reset without an extra packed register.
requirements.open: Storage-to-record-output copies and output-field writer admission remain required work.

requirements.contract: Typed IAL0 size/interface carriers preserve packed width and authored most-significant-first record order. Literal nested ranges and signed/state declarations are independent of the production layout producer. Strict generated carrier replay and complete SystemVerilog predecessor products pass.
requirements.open: Binary runtime does not prove X/Z behavior; signed/state declarations have structural witnesses.

requirements.contract: Successful check/semantic source.interface_ports and schedule/domain interface_ports preserve authored declaration order, nested leaf layout and JSON primitive kinds. Complete native/API/actual newline reports, discovery/catalog and unchanged supplied sources agree. Failure reports publish no invented successful declarations.
requirements.open: Full output-dependent aggregate consumer qualification remains .60.4.4.

requirements.contract: Original direct/named-domain/blocking observations pass literal packed copy/live/sample/hold/repeated-request/reset/idle checks and actual unsigned counterexamples under SystemVerilog parsing. Current ISF Verilog/v and selected VHDL profiles refuse precisely with destination atomicity; source/schedule inspection stays backend-neutral.
requirements.open: No X/Z or reset-free initialization guarantee, executable VHDL, legacy .fsm Verilog standards qualification, or historical EPERM cause is established. Future changed native scope needs fresh HIAL admission.
